Jade scales crossed by broad dull-gold bands wrapping around the trunk.
Cobra-like expanded hood, angular solid snake face, exactly two smooth backswept bone-white horns.
Yellow eyes with black vertical slit pupils.
One small black-violet Hush crack on brow, leaking sparse violet ash; never a hollow face.
Warm marsh creature: local steam/heat shimmer; cold slows it, frost on scales means it is failing.
